verdict.rationale: The docs show Python code execution via `runCode` (`print("hello world")`) and AI-driven data analysis in the sandbox. Terminal commands, a real Debian toolchain and custom templates suggest other languages could be run through shell commands or custom images. However, nothing documents first-class multi-language execution or structured rich outputs such as charts or result objects. Missing for 10: explicit JavaScript and other language runtimes in code execution, documentation of rich result types (charts, images, structured data), independent hands-on corroboration.
